subject: Draft listing & SLA check for AWS/Azure co-sell submission
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-07T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft listing & SLA check for AWS/Azure co-sell submission

Team — attaching the first pass of our AWS/Azure listing copy and the SLA matrix. Need quick policy/legal checks before we submit to co-sell intake next week. High level asks: 

- Branding & claims: make sure we aren’t using any restricted phrases ("enterprise-grade", "bank-grade") or implying bank/regulated endorsements.
- Support SLAs: confirm support scope (business hours vs 24/7), escalation contact, and whether we can commit to an SLA window in the listing.
- Co-sell eligibility: checklist items for each marketplace (AWS co-sell, Azure IP co-sell) — do we need an approved TAM listed?
- Attachments: Redwood_Listing_Draft.pdf (draft listing text), SLA-matrix.xlsx (proposed SLA variations), logo-guidelines.png (assets)

Please reply with line edits or redlines inline by EOD Friday. I'll consolidate and send to Ashley (AWS) and our Azure partner contact.

Thanks —
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-07T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft listing & SLA check for AWS/Azure co-sell submission

Thanks, Soojin — quick read-through, comments below. Inline redlines in the PDF; summarizing key items here: 

1) Branding & claims:
- Remove or rephrase superlatives: change "enterprise-grade" -> "production-ready inference platform". Avoid implying regulatory compliance unless certified.
- For performance claims we must add a test context line (e.g., "latency observed on p3.2xlarge in our tests; results may vary").

2) Support SLA:
- We should not promise <24/7 phone support for Standard tier. For the listing, propose offering: "Business-hours email & chat support (M-F, 9am-6pm PT) with optional 24/7 paid support add-on".
- The SLA-matrix.xlsx has a "4 hour P1" row for Standard — we should move that to Enterprise only.

3) Assets/Icons:
- logo-guidelines.png: red flag — AWS requires specific sizing and a trademark acknowledgement. I added a note to the file.

4) Co-sell items:
- We need to include our AWS Partner ID and co-sell registration status. For Azure, include the IP Co-Sell program enrollment ID.

I'm marking the SLA changes as high priority. If we want to be eligible for the co-sell badge, we should avoid ambiguous availability promises.

-M
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions & GTM | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-08T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft listing & SLA check for AWS/Azure co-sell submission

Adding a few practical items from the co-sell ops side: 

- For GCP and Azure co-sell we should add a short "how customers purchase" section (Marketplace private offers, Bring-your-own-license, Partner Solutions). That helps field teams route opportunities.
- I'll own the co-sell checklist — will attach the registration IDs once I verify them with partners.
- One ask from partners: include a support email alias that maps to our partner queue (partners-support@redwood.com) and a named escalation contact (level 2).

Also: small wording change suggestion — instead of listing an SLA pop-out in the marketplace description (which is short), include a link to "Support & SLA details" in a hosted doc/drive. Keeps the listing concise and avoids claim truncation.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Ashley Brown <ashley.brown@amazon.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Date: 2026-02-10T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft listing & SLA check for AWS/Azure co-sell submission

Hi Soojin / team — thanks for the draft. A few notes from the AWS Marketplace side before you upload: 

- Branding/Claims: AWS policy forbids language that implies endorsement by AWS (e.g., "AWS-powered" is okay if factual, but not "AWS validated"). Performance claims must be qualified, as Marissa suggested.
- SLA language: AWS will not let a listing promise guaranteed latency bounds (e.g., "<50ms") unless backed by an SLA with supporting telemetry. Your suggested "business-hours support with optional 24/7 add-on" is safe. 
- Co-sell/badge: to get co-sell referral, you will need an active Partner Network (APN) registration, your Partner ID, and a verified TAM listed. I can expedite the co-sell registration once you provide the Partner ID and the public support alias.
- Attachments: please include a short product one-pager (PDF) and a link to the SLA spreadsheet in Drive rather than embedding the full SLA in the listing text.

See AWS publishing guide: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/publishers/policy/ (attached here for convenience). I attached a short checklist.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if you want to walk through the remaining steps.

-Ashley
Ashley Brown
AWS Marketplace Partner Manager
[Attachment: AWS_Marketplace_Publishers_Checklist.pdf (PDF)]
